package.description: A next-generation bento-box organizer for the Windows desktop.

en-US.description: A next-generation bento-box organizer for the Windows desktop.
en-US.longDescription: BentoDesk is a next-generation bento-box organizer for the Windows desktop, powered by Rust and built for quiet elegance. Keep files in reach and noise out of sight: organize the desktop into zones and stacks that open, bloom, and go quiet again. The installer is per-user, fully offline and bilingual.
en-US.name: BentoDesk

zh-CN.description: 面向 Windows 桌面的新一代 Bento 收纳整理工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: BentoDesk 是一款面向 Windows 桌面的新一代 Bento 收纳整理工具，由 Rust 驱动，追求安静优雅。将文件置于触手可及之处，把杂乱藏于视线之外：把桌面整理成一个个区域与堆叠，打开、绽放、再归于平静。安装程序采用当前用户权限、完全离线并提供中英双语。
